def justify(words: list, width: int) -> list:
    if not words:
        return []

    lines = []
    i = 0
    n = len(words)

    while i < n:
        # Determine how many words fit on this line
        j = i
        line_len = 0
        while j < n:
            add = len(words[j]) if j == i else len(words[j]) + 1
            if line_len + add > width:
                break
            line_len += add
            j += 1

        line_words = words[i:j]
        is_last = j >= n

        if is_last or len(line_words) == 1:
            line = " ".join(line_words)
            line += " " * (width - len(line))
        else:
            total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in line_words)
            total_spaces = width - total_chars
            gaps = len(line_words) - 1
            base, extra = divmod(total_spaces, gaps)
            parts = []
            for k, w in enumerate(line_words[:-1]):
                parts.append(w)
                parts.append(" " * (base + (1 if k < extra else 0)))
            parts.append(line_words[-1])
            line = "".join(parts)

        lines.append(line)
        i = j

    return lines

def glob_match(pattern: str, name: str) -> bool:
    # Tokenize the pattern into: ("*",), ("?",), ("lit", ch), ("set", negate, items)
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    n = len(pattern)
    while i < n:
        c = pattern[i]
        if c == "*":
            # Collapse consecutive stars
            if not tokens or tokens[-1][0] != "*":
                tokens.append(("*",))
            i += 1
        elif c == "?":
            tokens.append(("?",))
            i += 1
        elif c == "[":
            j = i + 1
            negate = False
            if j < n and pattern[j] == "!":
                negate = True
                j += 1
            # A ']' immediately after '[' or '[!' is a literal member
            if j < n and pattern[j] == "]":
                j += 1
            while j < n and pattern[j] != "]":
                j += 1
            if j >= n:
                # No closing bracket: literal '['
                tokens.append(("lit", "["))
                i += 1
                continue
            start = i + 1 + (1 if negate else 0)
            body = pattern[start:j]
            items = []
            k = 0
            while k < len(body):
                if k + 2 < len(body) and body[k + 1] == "-":
                    items.append((body[k], body[k + 2]))
                    k += 3
                else:
                    items.append((body[k], body[k]))
                    k += 1
            tokens.append(("set", negate, items))
            i = j + 1
        else:
            tokens.append(("lit", c))
            i += 1

    def single_match(tok, ch):
        kind = tok[0]
        if kind == "?":
            return True
        if kind == "lit":
            return tok[1] == ch
        # set
        _, negate, items = tok
        found = any(lo <= ch <= hi for lo, hi in items)
        return found != negate

    # Iterative matching with backtracking to the last star
    t = 0
    s = 0
    star_t = -1
    star_s = 0
    nt = len(tokens)
    ns = len(name)
    while s < ns:
        if t < nt and tokens[t][0] == "*":
            star_t = t
            star_s = s
            t += 1
        elif t < nt and single_match(tokens[t], name[s]):
            t += 1
            s += 1
        elif star_t != -1:
            star_s += 1
            s = star_s
            t = star_t + 1
        else:
            return False
    while t < nt and tokens[t][0] == "*":
        t += 1
    return t == nt
